scenes.title: RelayCart incident response
lines: RelayCart connects safe incident response with customer recovery.

scenes.title: Healthy service and a verified checkout canary
lines: Start with a healthy service and a working checkout.
The canary creates an order, establishing the business baseline.

scenes.title: Deployment completes — but checkout fails
lines: Now deploy the broken release.
Deployment completes, but checkout fails. That is the incident trigger.

scenes.title: n8n correlates deployment, health and checkout signals
lines: n eight n correlates deployment, health, and checkout signals.
Duplicate signals do not create separate incidents.

scenes.title: One correlated SEV-2 incident; AI remains advisory
lines: One severity two incident captures the failure.
The model response is invalid, so its advice is rejected.

scenes.title: Bounded NIM investigation; schema validation stays enforced
lines: The investigation gathers evidence and calls NVIDIA NIM.
Invalid advice is rejected. Human approval stays enforced.

scenes.title: Human approval binds the exact release change
lines: The operator reviews the exact rollback, from version one point eight point two to one point eight point one.

scenes.title: Approve once; rollback and recovery checks execute
lines: Approval is single use, expires, and is bound to this release change.
The operator approves, then rollback and recovery checks execute.

scenes.title: Exact approval consumed; source release checked again
lines: The remediation workflow consumes approval and checks the source release again.
A newer release would block a stale rollback.

scenes.title: Verify release, health, checkout and order read-back
lines: Recovery checks the release, service health, checkout creation, and order read back.

scenes.title: Technical recovery requires all four business checks
lines: All four checks pass before the incident becomes recovered.
A green health check alone would not prove checkout works.

scenes.title: Durable customer fanout synchronizes live GHL cases
lines: The customer impact workflow synchronizes live GoHighLevel cases.
Durable retries keep the handoff recoverable.

scenes.title: 18 live Service Cases for checkout subscribers
lines: Eighteen checkout subscribers have Service Cases for this incident.
Historical cases are preserved.

scenes.title: Native GHL Service Case Intake workflow
lines: This published GoHighLevel workflow adds an intake note when a Service Case is created.

scenes.title: Native GHL Technical Recovery workflow
lines: The technical recovery workflow updates the case and enrolls associated records in confirmation.

scenes.title: Native GHL Conversation AI: working, broken or no reply
lines: Conversation AI asks whether checkout works again.
Explicit branches handle working, still broken, and no response.

scenes.title: Recovery confirmation question and explicit outcome branches
lines: Here is the actual recovery question and LiveChat configuration.
Silence cannot count as confirmed resolution.

scenes.title: Synthetic customer feedback
lines: Synthetic replies use the LiveChat test API to exercise real workflows.

scenes.title: Fresh replies drive outcomes; negative reply creates one task
lines: n eight n validates fresh replies and persists customer outcomes.
Negative feedback checks for an existing task before creating one.

scenes.title: Acme case: recovered and confirmed resolved
lines: Acme Bikes confirms checkout works.
Its case is technically recovered and customer confirmed resolved.

scenes.title: Ocean case: recovered but needs customer follow-up
lines: Ocean Apparel still needs help.
Technical status stays recovered while customer status becomes needs follow up.

scenes.title: Still broken: one incident-scoped follow-up task
lines: One support task captures the unresolved customer issue.
This count is scoped to the recorded incident; older tasks remain.

scenes.title: Technical recovery is not customer confirmation
lines: The final dashboard separates technical recovery from customer resolution.
One customer is resolved, one needs follow up, and sixteen await confirmation.

scenes.title: Verified incident and customer outcomes
lines: Verified recovery. Eighteen customer cases.
A clear handoff for the customer who still needs help.
